root_cause: Existing original composer dispatches only five candidates every five minutes. Legacy higher-priority LinkedIn-DM actions occupy all top-five slots; newly approved prepared email is excluded despite a successful Result Guardian fallback.
fix: Restore bounded fair slots inside same original SQL candidate RPC. Reserve at most two existing batch slots for original email candidates while preserving existing eligibility, composer source/quality and provider consent gates.
prevention_rule: Every canonical composer batch with pending prepared emails must offer at least one original email candidate for independent source/quality evaluation when capacity exists; internal pending or dispatched never means provider send. Preserve other channel slots and exact identity/consent and no-resend gates.

ci_failures.remediation: Explicit historical-type dependency check in same migration; no preview stub. Exact original production readback and native composer action evidence required.

preview_truth_boundary: A preview lacking original archived rowtype skips schema replacement with an explicit NOTICE. This is NOT a behavior test; original production SQL and native composer provider outcome remain required.
